name: Hoco EQ5 Energy Dual Mic ANC+ENC Bluetooth 5.3 True Wireless Earphone TWS Earbuds - Black
description:
Hoco EQ5 Energy True Wireless Earbuds – Dual Mic ANC+ENC, Bluetooth 5.3

Upgrade your listening experience with the Hoco EQ5 Energy TWS Earbuds, designed for crystal-clear calls, immersive sound, and ultimate convenience.

Key Features:

Advanced Noise Reduction (ANC + ENC): Dual noise-cancelling technology blocks ambient noise and background sounds, giving you a clear, uninterrupted audio experience.

Bluetooth 5.3 Connectivity: Fast and stable connection compatible with both Android and iPhone devices, ensuring seamless streaming and calls.

Dual Device Support: Connect to two phones simultaneously, so you never miss a call on either device.

Long Battery Life: Enjoy up to 7 hours of continuous usage, with the charging case providing 3 additional full charges. Standby time lasts up to 180 hours.

Convenient Charging & Display: USB-C charging port with a digital battery display keeps you informed and ready on the go.

Sweat-Proof & Built-in Microphone: Perfect for workouts, travel, or everyday use, with hands-free calling and superior sound isolation.

Specifications:

Type: True Wireless Stereo (TWS) Earbuds

Battery Life: 7 hours (earbuds), 3 full charges with case

Standby Time: 180 hours

Charging Port: USB-C

Noise Reduction: ANC + ENC

Connectivity: Bluetooth 5.3

Compatibility: Android & iPhone

Additional Features: Dual-device support, digital battery display, sweat-proof, built-in microphone

Experience premium sound and smart convenience with the Hoco EQ5 Energy Earbuds—designed for music lovers and multitaskers alike.
